critical_code_review_comments: ControlTowerPage.jsx L54,L65 — the two try/catch blocks in load() and runBackfill() swallow the actual Axios error object (bare `catch {}`). If the endpoint returns a structured 500/422 payload, the admin only sees a generic toast. Consider `catch (e) { console.error(e); toast.error(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Eroare...') }` for a more actionable message.

ControlTowerPage.jsx L11 imports `AdminLayoutMetronic` named-export; L73 uses it directly. Compare with AdminConsole.jsx that wraps children with the same layout. This is fine (same shell), but note: navigating between /admin (SPA state-managed) and /admin/control-tower (React Router route) causes a full remount of the layout, which re-renders the sidebar+topbar+LiveActivityRail. Minor UX/perf — no functional issue.

AdminConsole.jsx L64-68 — `useEffect` runs once on mount to strip ?tab= from URL. If a user opens /admin?tab=kyc, presses back-button after navigating away, the URL gets rewritten silently. This is by design per PRD but worth documenting: back-nav will land on /admin (not /admin?tab=kyc). Consider using `useSearchParams` + `setSearchParams({}, {replace:true})` for a more idiomatic React Router pattern.

control_tower.py L74-106 — the 'demand_no_supply' calculation runs 2 aggregations on `requests` + `users` every request. On larger datasets this may be slow. Consider caching via a materialized view or moving to a scheduled aggregation task if this dashboard becomes hot-path.

control_tower.py L20 — `_iso_days_ago` returns ISO string but queries assume string comparison on `ts` field. Works if all writes use isoformat() consistently, but a future writer using datetime object could produce false negatives. Consider ensuring a Mongo index on `ts` (string) + validating writers all use ISO strings.
kg/links.py L59 — links_of() runs 2 finds sequentially. For hot-path 1-hop walks, consider $facet aggregation for a single-round-trip. Not a blocker at KG-0 scale (1625 edges).

kg/links.py L40-49 — `link()` uses upsert. If the unique index isn't created before the first call (i.e., `ensure_kg_indexes()` not yet run), a race could allow duplicate edges. `backfill_entity_links` guarantees index first, but standalone link() callers must ensure the index. Consider calling `ensure_kg_indexes()` in an app startup hook.

Positive: Attention Layer schema in control_tower.py exactly matches Blueprint §8 recommendation contract {situatie/propunere/impact_estimat/actiune_1tap/sursa_semnalului} + severity sorting (critical→warning). Excellent adherence.

Positive: KG-0 is a well-scoped 'logical graph over Mongo' (per §12) — no external graph DB dependency, unique index prevents duplicates, backfill is truly idempotent (verified 2×: 1625→1625 total, 0 new).
